title: Where is islamic calendar and Egyptian calender
body:
Title: Disappointed - No Islamic or Egyptian Calendar Support ( 2 stars)

I downloaded the App with high hopes, looking for a new calendar app to streamline my life. It delivers on many fronts - the design is clean, the reminders are clutch, and overall it's a functional and powerful tool.

But for many Muslims like myself, there's a glaring omission: the lack of an Islamic calendar option. This is a significant oversight considering the importance of Islamic holidays based on the lunar calendar.

Frankly, in this day and age, inclusivity should be a priority for any calendar app. Integrating an Islamic calendar wouldn't just be a minor feature, it would demonstrate respect for a vast and diverse user base.

It has the potential to be the perfect all-in-one calendar app. But until it embraces the Islamic calendar, it falls short of that potential. Here's hoping the developers take note and make this crucial update.

I'm giving it 2 stars because it is a great app otherwise. But for Muslims like myself, it's missing a key feature that would make it truly indispensable.

title: Adjust the hijri date feature;)
body:
I’m uncertain if you know about the islamic date issue. Basically, the islamic date on ios calendar is behind the real date with a day. I hope that you try to fix it. It isn’t apple’s personal problem because it needs someone who understands that the Islamic date is variable that’s why some apps tend to add a feature where we can adjust the hijri date, where we can choose to minus a day or more, or to add a day or more, or leave it as it is

For simpler explanation, today is the 8th of the month 

We can choose either we wanna leave it the 8th or minus a day, two, or three from the written date so that it’s 7th, 6th, 5th 

Or do the opposite and add from 1-3 days so that’s 9th, 10th, 11th of the month (whatever the correct one, we get to choose bcz it differs from a country to another)

I hope you can add such a feature and I don’t mind explaining the whole thing if you’re willing to improve it.

Thanks!
